decisions.reason: Report pins the exact disabled expression in AttachmentChips, explains busy is local state of sibling AttachButton and unbound there, and shows the empty-occurrence early return skips the map while a present occurrence in plain phase makes the left guard false so busy evaluates to a ReferenceError.

Explains the slot error boundary catches the render throw and unmounts the whole dock entry, the attach button lives in a separate slot and survives, and the diagnostic appears only in the browser console with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 line to show busy predates the diff, proposes a rollback/re-add matrix plus a minimal data-present plain-phase mount for isolation, refuses to clear the hover diff unconditionally (notes its record?.items and event.target fragility and the imageItem-before-status/record scoping), and avoids claiming exactly when historical users first hit the failure.

Removes the dangling busy reference while preserving the phase guard (or threading an explicitly owned busy signal), adds record?.items ?? [] for missing arrays, optional-chained event.target?.closest?. for DOM targets, and explains why cheap defensive reads matter in slot components where a throw unmounts the entry.

Proposes a render smoke mounting AttachmentDock with one occurrence in plain phase, asserting the chip text renders and the error boundary captured nothing across both phases, explains the empty-state test returns null before the throwing line, and states node --check/lint parsing cannot resolve free identifiers or execute the component, recommending a data-present slot smoke as a pre-ship gate.
